testResults.name: pessimistic-fill-models
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/harness/fills/test_latency_size.py tests/harness/fills/test_trade_through.py -q
testResults.result: 15 tests passed for 300-share orders against 100 displayed shares, cancel/rest remainder policies, strict and non-strict print qualification, minimum trade-through thresholds, parameter-dependent outcomes, exact snapshots, and latency metadata.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed with exact Decimal arithmetic and no clock, random, network, or global configuration access.

decisions: SimulatedVenue owns response scheduling; LatencySize and TradeThrough expose latency as immutable execution metadata.
Inside-spread resting limits require qualifying prints by default, while optimistic quote fills require explicit configuration.
